reviews.note: A passing recollection while going through the archive; no new content beyond a major draft.
The spinning figure out of the pit again, with the new detail that the being that released it was angelic and from the Lord rather than demonic.
Adds the Belarus side of Warsaw and names Poland as the provoker rather than the victim.
Adds a provoking of the American military into it. He dates the vision only as years ago, which the recording cannot corroborate.
Ties the NATO withdrawal talk to the strait. Worth recording that he says the earlier vision had the previous president in it and that he had expected that president to act.
Places the sniffers in Cuba. He says outright that he does not understand what he is seeing.
Reading a news item about a plague on a boat and working out with his co-host whether it is hantavirus. Not a word of his own.
Continues the same news item. He says of it that it is not it though, refusing to bank the outbreak as the plague of plague-2027-china-rats-europe. Recorded in his favour.
The crowbar image again, with the addition that they are not hearing it on mainstream media.
Repeats the strait, the blame falling on Israel and the 1970s queues, and notes that the comparison is now being made publicly.
The Exodus wording again, given as a thing the Lord told him.
Named again in a prayer partly in tongues, alongside the Florida candidate of byron-florida-governor and prayer over Oklahoma and Texas.
The political theatre phrase again, here as an instruction to pick a side rather than as a forecast. He says he is tiptoeing around it.
Adds a new husband coming up beside the named widow. The opening of the passage restates youth-revival-colleges. Naming a living person's future remarriage is unusually specific.
Two hundred dollar oil again, prefaced by a not financial advice disclaimer.
Links two hundred dollar oil to a massive depression. He credits the economics to his son and another source rather than to a word, which is worth recording.
The fifty on a hundred image again, with the new detail that it was on a waving flag with half of it faded out. The ATM part restates bank-atms-go-dark.
Nobody with cash and the banks bankrupt, given as a vision he remembers clearly.
A call to prayer over Ukraine and Russia with no content attached beyond that he just saw it.
Watch South Korea and Japan in the days ahead. Watch with nothing named cannot fail, so the confidence is low and the row carries no window.
A correction he reports against himself and volunteers publicly, saying it blocked him in prayer until he apologised.
Adds the train stations to the subways and shows him reasoning out loud about which hour would carry the most impact, asking repeatedly when it is.
The weapon never used before on Warsaw again, with the French president named as a provoker, which restates macron-rises-like-hitler.
An extended passage in tongues with no interpretation given, so no content to record.
The dove now dead on the ground in Europe with ants at its eyes, and grey rather than white. No interpretation offered.
Two black crows with the cardinal, again with no interpretation. Nothing here can be checked until the animals are named.
Adds the panda talking to the dragon and to North Korea, and Taiwan glowing with yellow lights.
Adds a motive: the European provoking is traded for Russian help with Iran. Recorded separately from art-of-the-deal-nato, which has the strait rather than Iran as the currency.
